The same test passes with the boundary taken on a line end. The declared mutation, using the raw captured size as the boundary, is observed to fail that test with its log recorded. The follow, ticker, watch and row-policy test files named in the after_suite command of r-20260929T035930031370-rearm-replays-the-fleet-with-recorded-times show zero added failures by id against the dispatch base. The noise-pair case is known flaky at main, so compare it over five repeated runs. baseline_suite and after_suite are one-line JSON objects carrying revision, tree, the full command with no placeholders, exit_status, an absolute log_path, completed, failure_count and failure_ids
